Name: PIN_TYPE_PARAM_ST
Description: Marker pins that players place for their team, one row per pin type: how many a player can place, how long they last, how many allies can respond, and how they are drawn.

Fields.Name: Max Pins per Player
Fields.Description: How many pins of this type one player can have. Placing another removes that player's oldest one. Retail 1, 10, 1.

Fields.Name: Max Responses
Fields.Description: How many other players can respond to the pin. 0: none. Retail 2, 1, 0.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Lifetime
Fields.Description: Seconds the pin lasts after it is placed. Retail 180, 30, 15.

Fields.Name: Lifetime After Response
Fields.Description: When a player responds, the pin's remaining time is raised to at least this many seconds. -1: no change. Retail 240, 90, -1.

Fields.Name: Height Offset
Fields.Description: Metres added to the height of the pinned position. Retail 0, 0.75, 0.5.

Fields.Name: Other Players' Pin Time
Fields.Description: Seconds set on a pin placed by another player, reset once the pin has its maximum responses. What the timer shows is not established. Retail 20, 20, 10.

Fields.Name: Map Icon Scale
Fields.Description: Size multiplier of the pin's icon on the map (1 = normal). Retail 0.6, 0.7, 0.7.

Fields.Name: Distance: Near
Fields.Description: Distance in metres below which the pin counts as near; between near and far it counts as middle. Retail 50, 25, 25.

Fields.Name: Distance: Far
Fields.Description: Distance in metres from which the pin counts as far. Retail 300, 50, 50.

Fields.Name: Distance: Margin
Fields.Description: Metres a pin must move past a near/far boundary before its distance class changes, so it does not flicker at the edge. Retail 5.
